# OpenDMO API

Base URL: the same origin as the UI (default `http://127.0.0.1:8000`). All endpoints are under `/api`, return JSON unless noted, and are local-only by default. The machine-readable schema is at `/api/openapi.json` (the interactive Swagger page is disabled because it loads assets from a CDN).

Errors: `422` with `{"detail": "..."}` for validation problems, `404` for unknown ids or routes, `409` for conflicts (e.g. archived datasets).

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/assets` | list assets |
| POST | `/api/assets` | create assets |
| DELETE | `/api/assets/{row_id}` | delete assets |
| PATCH | `/api/assets/{row_id}` | update assets |
